Three weeks of building in public taught me more than three months of building in private.

What I shipped:
• a CSV cleaner that streams 2 GB files
• a fix for a timezone bug I'd ignored for days

What I learned: "small numbers, real people" beats vanity metrics every time. 41 users, and every one of them taught me something.

#buildinpublic #python
Postgres tip that saved me hours: run EXPLAIN ANALYZE before you add an index, not after. Most of my "slow queries" were the app, not the database.
Starting something new: one small tool a week, shipped in public. Follow along if you like seeing the messy middle, not just the launch posts 🙂
